slice: proof-first rescue assignment-prefix flow and complete union consumers

baseline.description: Exact release binaries preserved immediately before this rescue-prefix slice.

semantic_evidence.red_reproduction: With value = Product.new before begin, value = Text.new followed by a raising call inside begin, rescue incorrectly published Product only. An exception can enter rescue before or after the assignment commits, so the exhaustive receiver is Product | Text.
semantic_evidence.accepted_rescue_rule: During the existing recursive protected-body traversal, each active rescue frame observes the prior local value before an assignment RHS and the new value after a successful write. Every rescue clause starts from the canonical union of all observed assignment prefixes overlaid on the pre-begin environment. Nested protected bodies update every active outer frame; rescue, else, and ensure execute only after the matching frame is popped. Unknown absorbs the union.
semantic_evidence.accepted_union_rule: A union call, definition lookup, or signature lookup succeeds only when every receiver member has an exact visibility-admitted method result. Return types and definition/signature results are then combined deterministically; one missing, private, unavailable, or unresolved member fails closed.
semantic_evidence.diagnostic_rule: A concrete union dispatch proven by the shared fail-closed return resolver cannot also emit unresolved-method from the legacy single-owner reference candidate. Incomplete union outcomes are not suppressed.
semantic_evidence.architecture: Rescue flow remains inside ruby-analysis TypeTracker, complete MRO/visibility resolution remains inside AnalysisQuery, and CLI/LSP query modules only project engine results. The implementation adds no second AST walk, semantic store, or retained cache.
semantic_evidence.performance_refactor: The initially correct public-method proof rebuilt a growing HashSet for every method and pushed visitor median over the 3 percent gate. The accepted design maintains one incrementally updated Arc<HashSet>; tracker handoff is O(1), and inherited visibility overrides remain engine-owned.
semantic_evidence.scorecard: 85/85 reviewed cases, 100/100 points, revision m0-seed-22, score_eligible=false, claim_eligible=false
semantic_evidence.workspace_tests: cargo fmt --all -- --check, git diff --check, and cargo test --workspace -- --test-threads=4 exited 0; all extension, integration, black-box, and doc-test targets passed
semantic_evidence.lifecycle: The same source transitions from Text, to a complete Product | Text rescue receiver, to a private-member incomplete union, to an unresolved protected assignment, and back to Text. Hover, completion, chained-call hover, definition, signature help, diagnostics, and method-return inlays invalidate and recover together. Complete union navigation returns both definitions; the private and unresolved variants return none.
semantic_evidence.cli_result: All five fresh final-release processes produced byte-identical normalized JSON. The diagnostic-present fixture intentionally exits nonzero before the hashing pipeline.

performance.noise_note: The 100-iteration definition movement was 0.625 microseconds in one order and 1.625 microseconds in the reverse; at 500 iterations it narrowed to 0.084 microseconds. The 500-iteration hover difference is 0.958 microseconds on an unchanged hover query path. Diagnostic percentages likewise represent fractions of one microsecond. Fixed absolute budgets pass in every measured process.
performance.decision: Accepted. The exact final candidate is flat or faster on the 225,569-byte inference path, all material 500-iteration interactive deltas are below 3 percent, retained heap is unchanged, microsecond-floor movements remain thousands of times below fixed budgets, and every correctness and production budget gate passes. This does not replace the goal-wide warm-cache, allocation, worker-schedule, real-project precision, packaging, or two-project RSS acceptance matrix.

known_follow_ups: The scorecard remains deliberately claim-ineligible despite its seed-corpus score.

The legacy stored method-reference candidate still has one owner. Definition and signature queries now handle complete union receivers, but indexing one union call as references to every proven member requires a grouped receiver-target representation in a later slice.

A complete method whose return type is itself unresolved still needs a union-aware diagnostic target representation; this slice suppresses the contradictory unresolved-method diagnostic only when the complete union return proof is concrete.
The goal-wide real-project diagnostic review and cold/warm/allocation/scheduling/two-project RSS matrix remain open.
